Test_Scenario: Verify advocate can sync case matter data via eCourts CNR Number lookup from the Advocate Terminal.
Execution_Steps:
1. Log in and land on the Advocate Terminal (/dashboard).
2. Locate the 'Enter eCourts CNR Number to Sync Matter' input field.
3. Enter a valid 16-digit CNR number.
4. Click the Sync button.
5. Observe the sync progress indicator and resulting toast notification.
Expected_Result: The system calls the eCourts sync endpoint (with a simulated 2.5s fallback if the live endpoint is unreachable), displays a success toast, and the synced matter/hearing data appears in Tracked Cases and Legal Calendar.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Legal Triage Metrics tiles, Morning Triage panels, and Quick Actions grid render live data and navigate correctly.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to the Advocate Terminal (/dashboard).
2. Verify the 4 Legal Triage Metrics tiles display: Limitation Expiries (next 7 days), Pending Judgments, Drafts Pending Review, Tracked Cases.
3. Verify the 'Urgent — Next 48 Hours' panel lists upcoming calendar events and 'Recent Workspaces' lists recently created vault documents.
4. Click each tile in the Quick Actions grid (Upload Document, Contract Analyzer, Court Resources, Legal Calendar, Conflict Engine, Virtual Courtroom).
Expected_Result: All 4 metric tiles show live, non-placeholder counts pulled from backend data; Morning Triage panels populate correctly; each Quick Action tile navigates to its corresponding module.

Test_Scenario: Verify uploading a contract triggers the AI risk scan with the asymptotic progress bar animation.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to Contract Analyzer (Contract Risk Analyzer, /contract-analyzer).
2. Upload a sample contract document (PDF/DOCX).
3. Observe the scan progress bar as analysis runs.
4. Wait for the scan to complete.
Expected_Result: Progress bar advances using an eased/asymptotic curve (fast initial progress that decelerates and holds near 95% until the real completion signal snaps it to 100%); the full risk analysis report renders once the scan finishes.

Test_Scenario: Verify clause-level risk classification displays correctly as High/Medium/Low pills.
Execution_Steps:
1. Complete a contract scan in Contract Analyzer.
2. Review the clause-by-clause risk breakdown.
3. Identify clauses tagged RED, AMBER, GREEN internally by the risk engine.
Expected_Result: Each clause displays a corresponding High (RED), Medium (AMBER), or Low (GREEN) risk pill, matching the backend risk classification returned by the analysis engine.

Test_Scenario: Verify selecting clause text in the split-pane editor surfaces the contextual bubble menu with a Comment action.
Execution_Steps:
1. Open the Auto-Draft split-pane workspace tab for an analyzed contract.
2. Select (highlight) a span of clause text in the editor.
3. Observe the contextual bubble menu appear above the selection.
4. Click Comment and enter a remark.
Expected_Result: Bubble menu appears with Comment and Draft Revision options; clicking Comment attaches an inline comment/annotation to the selected text.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Draft Revision bubble menu action generates an AI-suggested rewrite as a live Track Changes suggestion.
Execution_Steps:
1. In the Auto-Draft split-pane workspace, select a risky clause.
2. Click Draft Revision from the contextual bubble menu.
3. Wait for the AI-suggested rewrite to generate.
4. Review the inline Track Changes markup (insertions/deletions) and accept or reject the suggestion.
Expected_Result: The AI-suggested rewrite is applied as a live Track Changes suggestion (strikethrough/insert marks) in the editor, and the advocate can accept or reject the change.

Test_Scenario: Verify the chat-with-contract panel answers questions grounded in the uploaded document.
Execution_Steps:
1. With a contract loaded in Contract Analyzer, open the chat panel.
2. Ask a question about a specific clause or obligation in the contract.
3. Review the AI response.
Expected_Result: The chat panel returns an answer derived from the uploaded contract's content, referencing the relevant clauses.

Test_Scenario: Verify the recommendations panel and autofill-from-template functionality.
Execution_Steps:
1. Complete a contract analysis.
2. Open the Recommendations panel and review the suggested improvements.
3. Trigger Autofill Template to populate a standard clause/template from extracted contract data.
Expected_Result: Recommendations panel lists actionable, contract-specific suggestions; autofill correctly populates template fields from the extracted contract data.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Export & Deploy modal correctly exports the analyzed/edited contract as PDF and DOCX.
Execution_Steps:
1. After analyzing/editing a contract, click Export & Deploy.
2. Select PDF format and export.
3. Repeat and select DOCX format and export.
4. Open both downloaded files.
Expected_Result: PDF is generated via the fpdf2-based export pipeline and DOCX via the DOCX export pipeline; both files open correctly and reflect the edited contract content including any accepted Track Changes.

Test_Scenario: Verify an analyzed contract can be saved directly to the Case Vault from Contract Analyzer.
Execution_Steps:
1. Complete a contract analysis.
2. Click Save to Vault.
3. Choose a destination folder in Case Vault.
4. Confirm save.
5. Navigate to Case Vault and locate the saved document.
Expected_Result: The contract (with analysis results) is saved into the selected Case Vault folder and is retrievable from the Vault document grid.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Supreme Court tab displays virtual hearing details, courtroom video links, and display boards.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to Court Directory & Resources (/court-resources).
2. Select the Supreme Court tab.
3. Review virtual hearing details, courtroom video links, and display board information.
Expected_Result: Supreme Court tab loads current virtual hearing links, courtroom video links, and display board data without errors.

Test_Scenario: Verify the High Courts tab provides state-wise cause list URLs and e-Filing links.
Execution_Steps:
1. On Court Directory & Resources, select the High Courts tab.
2. Select a state from the list.
3. Click the generated cause list URL and e-Filing link for that state's High Court.
Expected_Result: Cause list and e-Filing links are correctly generated per selected state and open the corresponding High Court resource.

Test_Scenario: Verify the District Courts tab's judge roster lookup returns judge name, designation, and court hall.
Execution_Steps:
1. Select the District Courts tab.
2. Search/select a district court.
3. Review the judge roster listing.
Expected_Result: Judge roster displays judge name, designation, and court hall sourced from the district judges database.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Bare Acts tab allows statute lookup across IPC/BNS/CrPC/PoSH/FEMA.
Execution_Steps:
1. Select the Bare Acts tab.
2. Search for a specific section (e.g., an IPC or BNS section number).
3. Review the returned statute text.
Expected_Result: The correct statute section text is returned for the selected act and section number.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Legal Forms tab within Court Resources fetches and downloads a court form.
Execution_Steps:
1. Select the Legal Forms tab.
2. Search/select a court form.
3. Click download/fetch.
Expected_Result: Selected form is fetched and downloaded successfully.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Legal Events tab lists upcoming legal events via the events API.
Execution_Steps:
1. Select the Legal Events tab.
2. Review the list of events returned from /api/legal-events.
Expected_Result: Legal events load and display with correct date/description information.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Fee Calculator tab computes court fees correctly.
Execution_Steps:
1. Select the Fee Calculator tab.
2. Enter case type/claim value inputs required for calculation.
3. Submit to calculate.
Expected_Result: POST /api/calculate-fee returns the correct computed fee for the given inputs.

Test_Scenario: Verify the e-Notary tab lists digital notarisation gateway options (NeSL, Leegality, SignDesk, Digio).
Execution_Steps:
1. Select the e-Notary tab (Digital Document Notarisation).
2. Review the listed gateway provider cards.
3. Click through to a provider (e.g., Leegality or Digio) badged Stamping & e-Sign / KYC Gateway.
Expected_Result: All four gateway provider cards (NeSL, Leegality, SignDesk, Digio) display with correct badges, and clicking a provider navigates to/opens the correct external gateway link.

Test_Scenario: Verify the IP Tracker tab supports full CRUD operations for IP assets.
Execution_Steps:
1. Select the IP Tracker tab.
2. Add a new IP asset entry with filing date and details.
3. Edit the entry.
4. Delete the entry.
Expected_Result: IP asset entries can be created, read, updated, and deleted successfully, with filing dates and details persisted correctly.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Malpractice Shield's Triage Search detects conflicts and generates a Clearance Memo.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to Conflict Engine (Malpractice Shield, /conflict-engine).
2. Select the Triage Search tab.
3. Enter a client/opposing-party entity name to check.
4. Review returned matches (Primary Client Match, Adverse Party Match, Case Title Match, Ingested Clause Match) and severity.
5. Click Generate Clearance Memo.
Expected_Result: Conflict matches are correctly classified and severity-escalated for high-risk matter types (criminal, matrimonial, writ); Clearance Memo is generated and saved to the conflict clearance memo records.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Cross-Document Uploader detects contradictions between two uploaded documents and allows copying a harmonized clause.
Execution_Steps:
1. On Conflict Engine, select the Cross-Document Uploader tab.
2. Upload two related documents containing conflicting clauses.
3. Run the AI cross-document analysis.
4. Review conflict cards showing severity (Critical/Major/Minor), excerpts from both documents, and Legal Explanation.
5. Click Copy Harmonized Clause on a conflict card.
Expected_Result: Contradictions are correctly identified and severity-classified; Copy Harmonized Clause copies the AI-suggested resolved clause to clipboard with a confirmation toast (Harmonized clause copied).

Test_Scenario: Verify adding a calendar event (Drop Dead Deadline, Hearing, or Task) triggers a conflict warning when clashing with an existing high-priority event.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to Legal Calendar (/calendar), the Tickler Engine.
2. Click a date that already has a high-priority event (drop_dead or appearance type).
3. Add a new event of type Hearing/Task/Drop Dead Deadline with an Opposing Counsel field.
4. Attempt to save.
Expected_Result: A conflict warning is shown when scheduling on a day with an existing high-priority event; the event still saves with the Opposing Counsel field recorded correctly.

Test_Scenario: Verify the AI-generated hover tooltip synopsis displays and calendar data feeds the Advocate Dashboard.
Execution_Steps:
1. On the Legal Calendar month grid, hover over an existing event.
2. Review the portal-rendered tooltip with AI-generated synopsis.
3. Navigate to the Advocate Dashboard and check the Limitation Expiries tile and Urgent — Next 48 Hours panel.
Expected_Result: Tooltip displays a correct AI-generated synopsis of the event; Dashboard widgets accurately reflect the same calendar data.

Test_Scenario: Verify recursive folder tree operations (create, rename, move, delete) in Case Vault with circular-parentage protection.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to Case Vault (/vault).
2. Create a new folder, then create a nested sub-folder inside it.
3. Rename the sub-folder.
4. Attempt to move the parent folder into its own child folder.
5. Delete the sub-folder.
Expected_Result: Folders can be created, renamed, moved, and deleted; the circular-parentage guard blocks moving a folder into its own descendant with an appropriate error.

Test_Scenario: Verify documents can be uploaded to a Case Vault folder via drag-and-drop.
Execution_Steps:
1. Open a folder in Case Vault.
2. Drag a document file from the local file system onto the upload zone.
3. Drop the file.
Expected_Result: The file uploads successfully and appears in the document grid within the target folder.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Vault search bar returns matching documents by name/content.
Execution_Steps:
1. In Case Vault, enter a keyword into the search bar.
2. Review the filtered results.
Expected_Result: Only documents matching the search keyword are displayed in the results grid.

Test_Scenario: Verify the document 3-dots context menu actions (Analyze, Summarize, Extract Facts, Download, Delete) work correctly.
Execution_Steps:
1. In Case Vault, click the 3-dots menu on a document card.
2. Select Analyze and verify it routes to/triggers Contract Analyzer.
3. Select Summarize and review the generated summary.
4. Select Extract Facts and review extracted facts.
5. Select Download and verify the file downloads.
6. Select Delete and confirm removal.
Expected_Result: Each context menu action performs its expected function (route to analysis, generate summary, extract facts, download file, delete with confirmation).

Test_Scenario: Verify the per-case Case Vault Directory view and the audit trail record document activity.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to a specific case workspace (/case/:caseId).
2. Review the Case Vault Directory document table and upload zone.
3. Upload a document via this view.
4. Check the Vault audit trail for the corresponding entry.
Expected_Result: Case Vault Directory displays the correct per-case document table; uploaded documents are listed; audit trail records the upload action with correct timestamp/user.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Litigation War Room executes its 5-stage animated pipeline end-to-end.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to Virtual Courtroom (War Room, /war-room).
2. Provide case facts/issue and start the simulation.
3. Observe the pipeline stages progress in order: (1) Extracting legal issues & case facts, (2) Searching Indian Kanoon for live precedents, (3) Drafting strategic opening argument, (4) Red-teaming with opposing counsel AI, (5) Compiling full simulation package.
Expected_Result: All 5 stages execute sequentially with correct status indicators, culminating in a complete simulation package.

Test_Scenario: Verify the War Room results page correctly displays extracted issues, live citations, drafted argument, and the Opposing Counsel Red Team rebuttal.
Execution_Steps:
1. After a simulation completes, review Section I: Extracted Legal Issues & Core Facts.
2. Review Section II: Live Supreme Court Citations & Precedents.
3. Review Section III: Drafted Opening Argument.
4. Review Section IV: Opposing Counsel Simulation — Red Team.
Expected_Result: Each section renders complete, relevant content; the Red Team section provides a substantive opposing-counsel rebuttal to the drafted argument, generated using only the approved precedent library (no fabricated citations).

Test_Scenario: Verify the Continuous Simulation Chat allows further back-and-forth with the opposing counsel AI after initial results.
Execution_Steps:
1. From the War Room results page, open the Continuous Simulation Chat.
2. Send a follow-up rebuttal or question.
3. Review the AI opposing counsel's response.
Expected_Result: Chat maintains simulation context and returns a coherent, on-topic opposing-counsel response.

Test_Scenario: Verify a completed War Room session can be saved in full to Case Vault.
Execution_Steps:
1. After a simulation session (including chat) completes, click Save Full Session to Case Vault.
2. Select a destination folder.
3. Confirm save.
4. Navigate to Case Vault to verify.
Expected_Result: The full session (issues, citations, argument, red-team rebuttal, chat transcript) is saved as a document in the selected Case Vault folder.

Test_Scenario: Verify Firm Library entries can be added across the 5 categories and the Clause DNA tab flags diverging precedents.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to Firm Library (/firm-library).
2. Click Add Entry and create an entry, selecting a category (Template, Precedent, Research Memo, Standard Form, Practice Guide).
3. Save and verify the entry appears in the library list.
4. Open the Clause DNA tab and review the Clause DNA Extractor output, including any Diverging Precedents risk flags.
Expected_Result: New entries save correctly under the selected category; the Clause DNA tab correctly surfaces diverging-precedent risk items for analyzed clauses.

Test_Scenario: Verify the Firm Library's Dual-Brain RAG search returns results with a reliability percentage bar and clickable citations.
Execution_Steps:
1. In Firm Library, enter a legal research query into the search bar.
2. Review the returned answer along with the reliability percentage bar (green/amber/red).
3. Review the Ratio Decidendi section and any risk-warning chips.
4. Click a citation link.
Expected_Result: The RAG backend (semantic router, ChromaDB, Groq synthesis) returns an answer with an accurate reliability percentage and color coding; citation links resolve correctly (e.g., to Indian Kanoon); risk-warning chips display when applicable.

Test_Scenario: Verify selecting a legal form template routes to the drafting workspace, supports AI-assisted drafting, and exports to DOCX.
Execution_Steps:
1. Navigate to Legal Forms Library (/legal-forms).
2. Select a template from one of the 3 categories (Legal Notices, Contracts & NDAs, Court Petitions) — e.g., Bail Application (S.439).
3. On redirect to the draft workspace, fill in fields manually or let AI draft a first pass from client facts.
4. Export the completed form as DOCX.
Expected_Result: Template list shows all 6 templates across 3 categories; drafting workspace opens with the correct template; AI-assisted draft populates fields from provided facts; DOCX export succeeds and produces a correctly formatted document.

Test_Scenario: Verify the LexAmplify AI Legal Associate overlay handles a streamed chat query, the Find Citation quick command, and saving the response to Case Vault.
Execution_Steps:
1. Click the LexAmplify button (sidebar or Dashboard) to open the AI Legal Associate overlay.
2. Enter a legal question and submit.
3. Observe the streamed response render progressively.
4. Use the Find Citation quick command to look up a specific case citation.
5. Click Save to Vault and choose a format (Native/PDF/DOCX).
Expected_Result: Overlay opens correctly via the button trigger; chat response streams progressively; the disclaimer footer (AI Legal Associate can make mistakes. Always verify critical legal information independently.) is visible; Find Citation returns the correct case reference; Save to Vault stores the response in the selected format in Case Vault.
